notes: Dragging a panel away from its snapped edge now clears Snap to Edge back to None, so it stops trying to return there and the Panel Editor's dropdown shows the truth.
Fixed the Default button next to each text color doing nothing — it was deleting the saved color but never actually reverting the panel's live color, across every theme.
Text tab now shows only the color levels a theme actually uses (OG: 2, not 4) and adds an Accent Color entry for themes that have one.
OG's unit text (%, °C, GHz, etc.) now uses the Text tab's Level 2 color instead of a dimmed copy of the value's own color.
